name: 三影敲门 · 人物传 VOL.4（高级）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP5《三影敲门》高级档（陷阱猎人版）语法命门 12 题。本卷的看图命门（13–18）、传记阅读（19–22）、单词接龙、角色互批区依赖纸面主图与机关，未进题库。

m5.q: Jun's mother gave the boys three ___ of bread before they left home.
m5.why: bread 不可数，要借量词计量；three 后面量词用复数 pieces。

m5.q: If the man ___ the door tomorrow, only one of the three boys will go in.
m5.why: if 引导条件状语从句，用一般现在时表示将来（主将从现），主句才用 will。

m5.q: The street was ___ quiet that the three boys could hear their own breath.
m5.why: so + 形容词 + that 从句，quiet 是形容词，只能用 so。

m5.q: Jie knocked ___ on the glass twice, but nobody inside answered him.
m5.why: hard 作副词意思是“用力地”，修饰 knocked，与“敲了两下却没人应”完全吻合。

m5.q: Ming ___ the same nine coins since his father went away two years ago.
m5.why: since + 过去时间点，主句用现在完成时，表示从过去一直延续到现在。

m5.q: A boy knocked at this door last summer. Nobody knows what ___ to him that night.
m5.why: happen 是不及物动词，只能用主动；last year 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时。

m5.q: The light behind the window is still on, so someone ___ be at home now.
m5.why: 灯亮着是证据，对现在情况作肯定推测用 must be，“一定在家”。

m5.q: The man behind the door never makes his students ___ him the same question twice.
m5.why: make sb do sth，主动语态下不定式要省略 to。

m5.q: Behind the door there is a small room ___ the man keeps every letter his students wrote.
m5.why: 先行词 room 表地点，后面从句 the man keeps every letter 成分完整，要用关系副词 where。

m5.q: The number of students who knock at this door ___ smaller year by year.
m5.why: 主语是 The number（数量），作单数；who 从句只是修饰 students，谓语用 gets。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: None of the nine coins has been spent.
There is nine coins on the step.
Each of them is waiting outside the door.
Neither of his two shoes is new.
m5.why: there be 用就近原则，最近的主语是复数 nine coins → There are nine coins on the step。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: The five prizes were won after midnight.
This door is opened only once a year.
The tenth place on the string is still empty.
The old ball is belonged to Jun.
m5.why: belong to 是不及物的状态动词，没有被动语态 → The old ball belongs to Jun。
